title: Enhance visual design and branding with professional logo and refined UI theming

requirements.text: Create a clean, modern logo for FocusGuard that represents focus, discipline, and productivity. The logo should be simple, minimal, and easily recognizable. Use a professional font and an icon that matches the concept of protection and concentration (shield, target, or focus symbol). The logo must work well in both light and dark modes.

quotes: Add a clean and modern logo that represents focus, discipline, and productivity. The logo should be simple, minimal, and easily recognizable.
Use a professional font and an icon that matches the concept of protection and concentration (shield, target, or focus symbol).

acceptanceCriteria: Logo is visible in the top-left corner of the Header component
Logo design is simple, minimal, and professional
Logo includes an icon representing protection/focus (shield, target, or focus symbol)
Logo renders correctly in both light and dark theme modes
Logo uses a professional, readable font for the FocusGuard text

requirements.text: Place the FocusGuard logo in the top-left corner of the Header component, ensuring it is prominently displayed and properly aligned with other header elements.

quotes: Place it in the top-left corner of the header and ensure it looks good in both light and dark modes.

acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the top-left corner of the Header component
Logo is properly sized and does not overlap navigation elements
Logo alignment and spacing are consistent with the minimal design aesthetic

requirements.text: Improve the Dashboard component appearance by adding soft shades, depth, and enhanced visual hierarchy. Use subtle background contrasts, refined card-based sections with rounded corners, and light shadows to make the dashboard feel modern and less flat.

quotes: Improve the dashboard appearance by adding soft shades, depth, and visual hierarchy. Use subtle background contrasts, card-based sections, rounded corners, and light shadows to make the dashboard feel modern and less flat.

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard cards use soft shadows for depth perception
Card backgrounds have subtle contrast against the page background
Visual hierarchy clearly emphasizes key statistics and metrics
Dashboard feels modern and three-dimensional rather than flat
Design maintains the calm, productivity-focused aesthetic

requirements.text: Refine light mode theming across all components with soft gray or tinted backgrounds and gentle shadows for visual separation. Ensure the color palette reduces eye strain and maintains readability.

quotes: Light mode: soft gray or tinted backgrounds with gentle shadows for separation
Ensure readability and reduce eye strain

acceptanceCriteria: Light mode uses soft gray or subtly tinted backgrounds
Shadows in light mode are gentle and provide clear visual separation
Text contrast meets accessibility standards for readability
Color palette is designed to reduce eye strain during extended use
Background and foreground colors are balanced and comfortable to view

requirements.text: Refine dark mode theming across all components with deep dark backgrounds and slightly lighter cards for smooth contrast. Ensure readability is maintained and eye strain is reduced in dark mode.

quotes: Dark mode: deep dark backgrounds with slightly lighter cards and smooth contrast
Ensure readability and reduce eye strain

acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode uses deep dark backgrounds (not pure black)
Card elements are slightly lighter than the background for smooth contrast
Text contrast is sufficient for comfortable reading in dark mode
Shadows and depth cues work effectively in dark mode
Dark mode color palette reduces eye strain during nighttime use

requirements.text: Maintain a clean, distraction-free layout with balanced spacing and consistent colors across both light and dark modes. The final design should feel calm, premium, and productivity-focused.

quotes: Maintain a clean, distraction-free layout with balanced spacing and consistent colors across both modes.
The final design should feel calm, premium, and productivity-focused.

acceptanceCriteria: Spacing between components is balanced and consistent
Color scheme is consistent across both light and dark modes
Layout remains clean and uncluttered
Overall aesthetic feels premium and productivity-focused
Design maintains a calm atmosphere suitable for focused study work

constraints: Do not modify the immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Maintain the existing React + Tailwind + Shadcn stack
Preserve all existing functionality while enhancing visual design
Ensure logo works properly in both light and dark themes without requiring separate logo files
nonGoals: Changing the application functionality or features
Modifying backend code or data structures
Adding new pages or navigation structure
Implementing animations beyond what already exists
Creating a full rebrand beyond the logo and visual refinements

required: Professional FocusGuard logo with shield/target/focus icon symbol and clean typography, suitable for both light and dark backgrounds (focusguard-logo.dim_200x60.png)
